title: C$^2$KV: Compressed and Composable KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Inference

problem.claim: Long-context LLM inference incurs growing costs from redundant prefill computation and from storing and accessing large KV caches.

gap.claim: Existing non-prefix KV reuse methods primarily target computation savings, while naive combinations of KV compression and reuse can cause severe accuracy degradation.

contributions.claim: C2KV is a unified framework for non-prefix KV reuse that jointly optimizes KV cache compression and concatenation.

C2KV uses a position-agnostic compressed KV cache manifold and a lightweight sidecar Extractor with learnable compression tokens and structured attention flow to produce modular KV representations that can be reused and concatenated without modifying the frozen base model.
C2KV employs compression-concatenation co-training to align extraction-time representations with downstream reuse behavior.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Across multiple long-context benchmarks and model families, C2KV significantly reduces KV cache storage and transfer costs.
C2KV achieves up to 17× inference speedup under long contexts.
The reported speedups preserve generation quality.

narrative_sequence.summary: Long-context inference is important for modern LLM applications.
Non-prefix KV cache reuse has been explored to reduce redundant prefill computation.
Prior methods overlook KV cache storage and access costs, and naive compression-reuse combinations can degrade accuracy.
C2KV jointly performs KV cache compression and concatenation using composable position-agnostic representations, a sidecar Extractor, and co-training.
The authors report reduced storage and transfer costs, up to 17× inference speedup, and preserved generation quality across multiple benchmarks and model families.

source_observation.claim: KV cache reuse can reduce redundant prefill computation, but long-context serving also faces storage and access costs for large caches.

interpretation.claim: Optimizing inference reuse may require addressing both computation and memory movement bottlenecks.

application.claim: When designing long-context serving optimizations, evaluate compute savings together with cache storage and transfer costs.

exception.claim: Combining compression with non-prefix KV reuse may severely degrade accuracy when the components are combined naively.

source_observation.claim: C2KV aligns extraction-time representations with downstream reuse behavior through compression-concatenation co-training.

interpretation.claim: Training intermediate representations for their intended downstream composition may improve reuse compatibility.

application.claim: For modular cache or representation reuse, consider co-training the extraction process with the target composition behavior.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this strategy generalizes beyond the reported long-context benchmarks and model families.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the benchmark names, model families, or experimental settings.
The abstract does not provide compression ratios, baseline comparisons, or detailed accuracy measurements.
